notes: Tail case. U1/U2 refs were left/right but both vaporettos sit near the canal centre: rewritten as nearer/farther white water bus; U2 replace was a recolor -> gondola. U3 mask was a building balcony at the far right (ref said centre, removal structurally odd) and U4 a fragment of one of many identical red terrace umbrellas: both retargeted (U3 small cargo boat, U4 foreground wooden motorboat) with SAM3 v2 masks.

difficulty.specific_protection_zh: 保留船只、建筑和运河设施。
